data.description: You make the touched poison difficult to detect or identify. Detect poison and similar effects detect an obscured poison only with a successful caster level check against a DC %1 (rolled secretly by the GM). Even if the poison is detected, the DC of Craft (alchemy) or Wisdom checks to identify the poison is increased by 10. If cast upon a venomous creature, obscure poison disguises all of the creature's natural poisons in the same way. Material component; herbs used in antitoxins worth 10 gp.|15=CASTERLEVEL|PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
